The performance rules in the JARVIS Command Center Design System permit only a static Node server. The same rules also exclude external fonts or UI frameworks, and a continuous canvas/WebGL dependency for the core dashboard. They require CSS-first visuals, with animations limited to low-cost transforms and opacity.

Source: `vault://projects.workspaces.jarvis_web/design_system` (sha256:bf148c03afe8, L1-L66). The "Performance Rules" section is near the end of that range.

ANSWER_PATH: vault://projects.workspaces.jarvis_web/design_system
ANSWER: Static Node server only ("Static Node server only." under Performance Rules).
